title: Use the Hotbar, Inventory, and Basic Tools
outcome: Child can open their inventory or creative menu, pick blocks they like into the hotbar, select between them during play, and use one basic tool for its job (axe on wood, shovel on dirt).
testedVersions: 1.21.x (Bedrock) - verify current patch at session prep
multiplayerRequirements: Solo: prepared local world. Shared: adult-owned Realm with child + mentor only.
knownIncompatibilities: Java inventory layout differs - never show Java screenshots

guardianSteps: Same device setup as previous module
Child should be signed in and ready to play
mentorPreflight: World 'BB Starter Plains' loaded in creative mode
Creative inventory confirmed accessible per input method
Control card ready for hotbar/inventory actions

mentorMoves: Ask about last session's exploring spot
Ask what they'd like MORE of today
Offer: 'Collect your favorite blocks' or 'Get tools like a real builder'
Guide opening the inventory once; celebrate loudly
Demonstrate picking one block into the hotbar
Point out the hotbar row at screen bottom
Ask 'Which block do you think will look best?' then let them choose 2-3
Suggest placing blocks from different hotbar slots
flow.childAction: Builds a small colorful pillar or patch using 3+ block types

mentorMoves: Offer swapping one block for another they just noticed
Ask which block is their favorite and why
Offer next steps: bigger build, animals, or follow a tiny tutorial

openingLines: Today you get to fill your own tool belt - ready?
Last time you explored. Today you collect!
keyPhrases: Open your backpack - that's your inventory!
That's your hotbar - it's like your pockets.

learnerCues.cueText: Press this to open your blocks

sharedRoles.childRole: Collector - chooses all blocks and tools
sharedRoles.mentorRole: Helper - points where menus are, never picks for them
sharedRoles.rotationNotes: Small groups: each child fills their own hotbar; no shared hotbar decisions

childChoicePoints.prompt: Which 3 blocks go in your pockets?
What should we make first with them?

commonProblems.fix: Mentor narrows to one tab/category at a time; search box if touch device
Re-demonstrate drag vs tap-to-slot per input method; check for touch long-press behavior
Celebrate the enthusiasm; suggest a 'shopping trip' back later rather than forcing limits

hintLadder: Where do you think your blocks live? Let's peek together.
See the three dots / E button? That opens it.
Tap the block once... now tap the pocket where you want it.
resetPath: Close and reopen inventory; hotbar contents persist in creative mode. If the world state got messy, mentor restores from the pre-session backup copy of BB Starter Plains.
soloFallback: Same goals work fully solo-guided: mentor narrates over screen-share while the child drives their own single-player world.
accessibilityOptions: Touch devices: enable 'Classic' creative inventory layout if grid overwhelms
safetyRequirements: Private world or adult-owned Realm; no public servers
No credential sharing; guardian handles sign-in
parentSummaryTemplate: Today {child} learned to use the Minecraft inventory and hotbar - they picked their own favorite blocks ({blocks}) and built {miniBuild}. Ask which block was their favorite!

review.notes: Needs human playtest per input method, especially touch drag-to-slot behavior.

worldSpecification.description: 'BB Starter Plains' continued from module 1: same flat creative world so prior exploration spot is visible.
